body:
GBM test9 - Fix black screen before login

Fixed the signed-out authentication container collapsing to zero width and height. The login navigator now fills the screen, including first installation and expired/missing session states. Existing authenticated home navigation remains mounted and hidden until login.

The failure was reproduced with the exact test8 APK on a separate Android user. A regression test now checks actual login page dimensions, tappable inputs and text entry in light and dark themes; the pre-fix test failed with width 0.0. All 49 private-network tests pass after the fix.

Version 5.5.11 (50511), release/AOT build, existing test signing certificate. Retains test8 engine storage fix. Exact final x86_64 APK checked on the previously black-screened test user. Physical ARM64 device execution has not been directly verified.

Install the ARM64 APK over your existing app. Legacy asset filenames are retained for updater compatibility.
